programme.notes: CIS also offers a BAS in Computer Science (Bachelor of Applied Science, /computer-science-bas/), recorded as a related variant; BSE is Penn's 'flagship Computer Science degree'. No language-of-instruction quote (US university, English). Owner ruling: US university without a CS-specific admissions page; the university-wide undergraduate admissions page is the source, scoped to the university.

english.notes: No minimum published. https://admissions.upenn.edu/how-to-apply/international-applicants: 'We accept TOEFL, IELTS Academic, and the Duolingo English Test.' and guidance only: 'Competitive applicants tend to have an overall band score of 7 or above' (IELTS), 'a composite score of 100 or above' (TOEFL 0-120), 'a composite score of 5 or above' (TOEFL 1-6), 'an overall score of 130 or above' (Duolingo). 'Competitive' ranges, not minimums.

gpa.notes: Prose only: 'we do not have explicit course requirements or minimum test score requirements for admittance' (https://admissions.upenn.edu/how-to-apply/international-applicants). No GPA minimum.

deadline.notes: Fall 2027 first-year entry; Early Decision November 1, 2026 (binding). International applicants use the same process: 'Our application process is the same for domestic and international applicants.' (international-applicants page). No time of day or timezone. Owner ruling: US university without a CS-specific admissions page; the university-wide undergraduate admissions page is the source, scoped to the university.

tuition.notes: Table under '2026-2027 Academic Year' (cost of attendance); fees $8,308 extra; total on-campus budget $99,082. The 2025-2026 table below it lists Tuition $63,204. 2027/28 not yet published. University-wide undergraduate figure.

scholarship_exists.quote: International students admitted as financial aid recipients will receive need-based aid that covers 100% of their demonstrated need, just like domestic students.
scholarship_exists.notes: Need-based (grant + work-study), not merit; Penn is need-aware for international applicants ('a family's ability to pay does factor into admissions decisions'). Size depends on a need assessment: NEED_BASED_POSSIBLE.

scholarship_international.quote: International students are eligible for financial aid, but must apply for financial aid at the same time as they apply for admissions in order to be considered.
scholarship_international.notes: 'Requests for financial aid after being admitted as an international student cannot be considered.'
